verdict.rationale: Docs confirm embeddings are available through the same unified API ('Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API' — together-ai-docs-21), letting developers generate embeddings without a separate vendor. However, no evidence in the pack documents a reranking endpoint or reranker models, so the 'rerank results' half of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: dedicated rerank API/model documentation, example embedding request/response, retrieval-pipeline integration guidance.
